attempted_migration.failure: The managed production postgres role could create the purpose role but could not SET ROLE to it for ALTER FUNCTION OWNER. The enclosing transaction rolled back.

forward_correction.decision: Keep the private wrapper owned by the existing production postgres owner; remove the unnecessary ownership transfer and extra NOLOGIN owner role.
forward_correction.new_regression: The PostgreSQL 17 migration test removes SUPERUSER from postgres before applying the migration, matching the managed production owner limitation.
